sql: WITH members AS (SELECT d.manager_id,d.manager_name,d.user_type,d.full_name,p.win_rate_percentage, max(p.win_rate_percentage) OVER(PARTITION BY d.manager_id,d.manager_name,d.user_type) maximum FROM marts.dim_salesforce__user d LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_salesforce__user_performance p ON d.user_id=p.user_id WHERE d.is_active) SELECT manager_id,full_name,win_rate_percentage,maximum FROM members WHERE full_name IN ('Christine Morrison','Heidi Turner','Dawn Bailey','Tony Lewis') ORDER BY manager_id,full_name
